connect-menu.name: connect-menu
connect-menu.scenario: The example. A line dragged from the bottom grip of `hosts` and let go on `app`, where two kinds fit.
items: A menu at the place the line was let go.
It lists "specializes" and "connection", one a row, and nothing else.
The dashed line from the grip of `hosts` to the menu's corner is still drawn.
`app` has a dashed teal outline.
The grips of `hosts` are shown, each clear of its port.
The menu covers no part of `hosts`.

label-editor.name: label-editor
label-editor.scenario: The example at 150%. `hosts` picked, then F2.
items: One text box over the name line of `hosts`.
It holds `hosts[1..*] : Host`, all of it selected.
The text is centred, in the size the name is drawn at.
The box is at least as wide as the name was.
The box's border is teal.
No other box or line has moved.

badges.name: badges
badges.scenario: The example, with `App` renamed to `Page`, so that two part defs have one name. The Validation panel is shown.
items: A round "!" badge at the top right corner of each of the two part defs named `Page`.
No badge on any other box.
Neither badge covers a keyword or a name.
The Validation panel says how many problems there are, in digits.
The panel lists the problem in a sentence that names `Page`.

notes.name: notes
notes.scenario: The annotations fixture, its view fitted, the Notes panel shown and the archive opened.
items: The Notes panel lists three notes, numbered 1, 2 and 3 from the top.
Note 1 says it is on part def Host; note 2 on the connection mount; note 3 on the plane.
Note 2 shows Claude's answer under its text and is marked resolved.
"Archive · 1" stands under the notes, with note 4 listed under it and a Restore button.
On the plane, pin 1 sits on the top edge of `Host`.
Pin 2 sits at the middle of the line `mount`, and is grey.
Pin 3 stands on the empty plane and is hollow.
No pin covers a name or another pin.
No text of a note is cut off.

text-tab.name: text-tab
text-tab.scenario: The example, its text tab in front.
items: A tab titled `StrongholdProof.sysml` beside the view's tab, in front.
The text begins `package StrongholdProof {`.
The text is in a fixed-width font and its lines are not wrapped mid-word.
A Copy button at the top of the tab.
A line at the top that says no problem was found.

sequence.name: sequence
sequence.scenario: The sequence fixture, `loginSequence` fitted, both sides collapsed.
items: Three heads in one row at the top, left to right `client`, `server`, `auth`, each a rounded box with «part» and its name line.
A dashed line down from the middle of each head, as long as the others.
Two dots on the line of `client`, named `loginSent` and `loginDone`.
Four arrows, each on a row of its own, from the top: `login`, `checkCredentials`, `credentialsOk`, `loggedIn`.
Each arrow is level, has a closed, unfilled head at the end it goes to, and its name above it.
`login` starts at the dot `loginSent`, and `loggedIn` ends at the dot `loginDone`.
Pin 1 at the middle of `login`.
No name overlaps a line or another name.

geometry.name: geometry
geometry.scenario: The geometry fixture, `plan` fitted, both sides collapsed.
items: `room` as a rectangle a third wider than it is high.
Inside it `desk` and `cabinet` as smaller rectangles and `pillar` as a circle.
`desk` is left of `cabinet`, and `pillar` is above both, between them.
Each footprint has two lines of words: «part» and its name; its shape with its dimensions and unit, as "Box 2 × 1 × 0.75 m".
The words of a small footprint are below it, not across its outline.
Two axes from the lower left corner of `room`, named x and y, x to the right and y up.
A scale bar under the x axis that reads "1 m" and is an eighth as long as `room` is wide.
Pin 1 on `desk`.

grid.name: grid
grid.scenario: The grid fixture, `elementTable` in front, both sides collapsed.
items: A table with one header row: kind, name, type, multiplicity, owner, doc, specializes.
Thirteen rows under it.
The header is set apart from the rows by weight or ground.
Every cell's text starts at its column's left edge, and a text too long for its cell ends in an ellipsis.
The row of `Host` carries pin 1 at its right end.
The table is as wide as the tab or scrolls; no column is cut off without a scroll bar.

browser.name: browser
browser.scenario: The browser fixture, `modelTree` in front, both sides collapsed.
items: A tree of rows, one for each element, each reading «keyword» then its name, with `: Type [multiplicity]` for a usage.
What an element owns is under it, stepped in a level.
The row of `Host` is folded: its triangle points right and nothing is under it.
The lines are rows too, under the element they are declared in, as «connection» mount.
The row of `hosts` carries pin
Every row is as high as the others, and no row's text is cut off.
